entities.summary: Guido Maggiorino Gatti (1892–1973) was an Italian musicologist, editor, administrator, and music critic. In 1920 he founded the journal Il Pianoforte, which later became La Rassegna Musicale  in 1928 and Quaderni della Rassegna musicale in 1962. In 1972 he founded the journal Studi musicali. He was music critic for Tempo from 1951-1969, and also as an administrator for various performing arts institutions in Italy.
